description: Use when assessing a company IP portfolio strength, tracking competitor patent activity, or preparing M&A patent due diligence. Returns USPTO filing rollups by assignee — patent counts, filing years, and CPC classification. Example: Qualcomm — 47,000+ active patents, 3,200 filed in 2023, concentrated in 5G and AI/ML — top 3 CPC codes represent 61% of portfolio — IP moat assessment critical for semiconductor M&A. Source: USPTO PatentsView synced data. $0.02 USDC per call.
name: get_uspto_patent_intelligence
title: Get Uspto Patent Intelligence
